classification: Wyckoff-style failed-support-break/spring-reclaim structural research proxy; not a certified Elliott-wave or Wyckoff classification
hypothesis: A causally confirmed L0-H1-L2 spring (brief lower-low liquidity sweep that returns above prior support L0 before reaching H1) may provide earlier reversal participation than the rejected ABC H0-LA-HB-LC rally above HB. It is a structurally different three-pivot sequence, not an amended ABC v11 trigger.

prior_evidence.reason_for_separate_topology: The rejected ABC model waited for the second high to break and frequently hit ATR stops; testing an independent support-sweep/reclaim structure is a new hypothesis rather than fitting cost or gate thresholds to prior losses.

feed.decision_timestamp: 15m candle CLOSE; raw archive timestamp means OPEN

pivot_geometry.same_kind_replacement: retain only more extreme newly confirmed pivot within current same-kind run; no hindsight rescans
pivot_geometry.strict_order: L0.index < H1.index < L2.index; L2.confirmed_at=L2.index+3 and decision_index > confirmed_at
pivot_geometry.sweep_ratio_reason: A small failed penetration relative to the known L0->H1 response is the structural definition of a spring, preregistered once, no retrospective tuning.
pivot_geometry.path_validation: Between L0 and H1 raw lows must not breach L0; between H1 and L2 raw highs must not exceed H1 nor lows breach L2; after L2 and through its three-right-bar confirmation, no raw low may be below L2 and no close may have already reclaimed L0. Intrabar ambiguous dual-pivot and invalidated paths fail closed.
pivot_geometry.stop_on_new_confirmed_pivot: invalidate former spring setup before forming a new one; one state identity only
pivot_geometry.limits: This is a proxy for a three-leg spring, not market microstructure order-book proof or an Elliott count.

trigger.event: First fresh CLOSED 15m close strictly above L0 with previous CLOSED 15m close at or below L0, while low on current bar has not breached L2 and high has not exceeded H1; this is a structural support reclaim, not an HB resistance breakout
trigger.invalidate_before_trigger: current 15m LOW < L2, or current 15m HIGH > H1; structural setup expire if age > 16, superseding confirmed pivot
context: unchanged fixed 25+15 bps stress cost gate
trigger.context_note: h1_vol_ok means closed-1h candle-range/volatility normalized versus lagged 72-hour reference, never traded volume
trigger.entry: NEXT 15m candle OPEN only; never on decision candle
